description: This file contains a report implementation for exponential smoothing forecasting within the ERPNext manufacturing module, including classes for forecast calculation, data preparation, and report generation.

classes.name: ExponentialSmoothingForecast
classes.description: Class implementing exponential smoothing forecast calculations and data handling.

classes.name: ForecastingReport
classes.description: Class extending forecast calculations to generate a report with data, charts, and summaries.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to run the report with optional filters.

methods.name: forecast_future_data
methods.description: Calculates forecasted data for future periods based on exponential smoothing.

methods.name: prepare_periodical_data
methods.description: Prepares period-wise data for forecasting based on input filters and database data.

methods.name: get_data_for_forecast
methods.description: Fetches relevant data from the database for forecast calculations.

methods.name: prepare_final_data
methods.description: Prepares the final dataset for report output.

methods.name: add_total
methods.description: Calculates and adds total summary row to the data.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Generates column definitions for the report.

methods.name: get_chart_data

methods.name: get_summary_data
